queries: WITH q AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS qty FROM Order_Items), base AS (SELECT AVG(qty) AS baseline FROM q), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM q GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.baseline) IS NULL, p.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS qty FROM Order_Items), base AS (SELECT AVG(qty) AS baseline FROM q), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM q GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.baseline) IS NULL, p.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to a number. Blank or whitespace-only strings count as missing, like NULL.
The baseline is the plain average over all non-missing order-item rows. If no row has a quantity, the baseline is NULL and the query returns no rows.
Orders whose items all have missing quantities are kept, with a NULL average and NULL difference. They sort last.
Ties in the difference are not broken, so which tied orders make the top 10 is arbitrary.
